home.title: Help
home.description: [Amazon Bedrock](https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock) offers access to a diverse range of large language models. This demo showcases how foundation models can be accessed through a single Bedrock API to serve multiple usecases

doc-chat.title: Document Chat
doc-chat.description: Store your documents on [Amazon OpenSearch Serverless](https://aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/features/serverless/) and query those documents in natural language. Supports multiple languages and multiple FMs on Amazon Bedrock

doc-chat-manage.title: Manage Documents
doc-chat-manage.description:
Upload documents that are indexed into a [Bedrock Knowledge Base](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/knowledge-base.html) backed by [Amazon OpenSearch Serverless (NextGen)](https://aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/features/serverless/).

### Sync Status

After uploading or deleting documents, an ingestion job syncs your files to the Knowledge Base index. The status indicator above the table shows:

- **Sync in progress** — Files are being processed (auto-refreshes every 5s)
- **Last sync complete** — Shows timestamp, documents indexed, and any failures
- **Last sync failed** — Check file formats or permissions

Supported formats: PDF, TXT, MD, HTML, DOC, DOCX, CSV.

**Tip:** Files become searchable in Document Chat within 1–3 minutes after sync completes.

You only ever see your own documents. The *Show all users* view appears for members of the `corpus-readers` group, and even then it lists file names and owners only — opening a document still requires owning it.

multi-agent.title: Multi Agent
multi-agent.description:
Here we have multiple GenAI agents working together to solve a user problem. You could use agents to generate presentations/search the web/build applications, games and much more. All of this in a few seconds without writing any code.

Web research uses AgentCore's managed web search, so the agents can search the web but cannot be talked into fetching an arbitrary URL.

evaluation.title: RAG Evaluation
evaluation.description:
Evaluate your RAG system's quality using [Amazon Bedrock Evaluations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/evaluation.html).

### Manual Entry (Reference-Free)

Type one question per line. The system will generate answers from your Knowledge Base and score them without needing expected answers.

```
What is the join process?
How do I submit a claim?
What are the waiting periods?
```

### File Upload (Reference-Free)

Upload a JSON file with an array of questions:

```json
[{"question": "What is the join process?"}, {"question": "How do I submit a claim?"}]
```

### File Upload (Ground Truth)

Enable **Ground Truth Mode** and upload a JSON file with questions and expected answers:

```json
[{"question": "What is the join process?", "expected_answer": "Submit application online, receive email confirmation..."}, {"question": "How do I claim?", "expected_answer": "Log into member portal, select Claims..."}]
```

### Metrics

- **Faithfulness** — Is the answer grounded in retrieved context? (no hallucination)
- **Correctness** — Is it factually correct?
- **Completeness** — Does it cover all relevant info?
- **Helpfulness** — Is it useful to the user?
- **LogicalCoherence** — Is the reasoning sound?
- **ContextRelevance** — Are retrieved chunks relevant?
- **ContextCoverage** — Do chunks cover what's needed?

**Tip:** Evaluations are async and typically take 2–5 minutes. You can navigate away and check results later in the Recent Evaluations table.
